_note: What a town resident is made of (npc's resident cards): rolled once by worker id (ResidentCard.roll) when first needed and kept on the worker record ('card'), so the same resident rolls the same. Each entry is a few plain words, never prose or a line to say; no place is named (the land's and the town's names are open: lore's primer). 'came' is how they came to the town when the record's origin says nothing real; a rescued resident's is written from the rescue instead. 'kin' and 'grudge' are rolled at founding against a neighbour already in the town (chance per 1). 'growth' caps the facts a card gathers from events.
birthplace: a farmstead east of the town
a charcoal burners' hamlet in the forest
a steading a long road to the south
a shepherds' hut in the hills
the inn, in a room over the yard
parentage: a foundling left at the temple door
came: came as a child when the family farm failed
came after the raiders burned the village
came with a caravan and stayed when it moved on
walked in alone one winter and found work
came looking for a brother who had gone ahead, and never found him
came to work the forge for a season and stayed
hobby: watching the road from the wall
telling old tales to the children
speech: a blunt way, with no softening

causes: over a word said at the inn
over a share of a harvest

look._note: What a resident looks like, rolled with the card by worker id, words the voice can say and pc-character's generator maps to a body (seed: the id's hash, for the details no word names); agreed with pc-character 2026-10-17.
